faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Bharathidasan University Senior Research Fellow (SRF) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 22nd August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the university before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess an M.Sc, B.E, B.Tech, B.VSc, B.Pharm, or equivalent degree with at least two years of research experience. An M.E, M.Tech, MBBS, BDS, M.VSc, or M.Pharm degree is also acceptable. Experience in Theoretical Physics with computational skills is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this post is 32 years. Age relaxation is provided for SC/ST, OBC, women, and physically handicapped candidates.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 42,000 per month, plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the type of job for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q8. Which university is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Bharathidasan University.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post.

faq.question: Q10. How should I send my application?
faq.answer: Applications should be sent via email. Ensure all required documents are attached and the subject line is clearly mentioned.
